ValidationRule.description: An existing Account Location can change only if Override Location was ticked before the save. System Administrators are exempt. Blank locations can be filled. Author: Tharun N | Date: 04-11-2026
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISCHANGED(Account_Location__Latitude__s), ISCHANGED(Account_Location__Longitude__s) ), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Account_Location__Latitude__s))), NOT(ISBLANK(PRIORVALUE(Account_Location__Longitude__s))), NOT(PRIORVALUE(Location_Override__c)), $Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator' )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Account Location is locked. Ask Lakshman, Yadav or the Salesforce admin to tick Override Location, then capture the location from the Account Location card in the Salesforce app on your phone.
